articles.title: Why Sandisk and Western Digital crashed 10% and what it means for bitcoin
articles.snippet: Strong earnings from SanDisk and Western Digital were not enough to satisfy investors, raising questions about whether capital is beginning to rotate from AI winners into crypto.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies above $64,000 as traders watch $100 billion SpaceX unlock
articles.snippet: Korea's Kospi fell 4.4% as the AI trade wobbled, and $101 billion of SpaceX stock becomes tradable Thursday.

articles.title: XRP whales keep buying the dip, but ether shows deeper capitulation
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant said large XRP spot orders point to "quiet accumulation" rather than a breakout, while ether’s price below realized value leaves holders underwater and gives it the strongest valuation case among BTC, ETH and XRP.

articles.title: Ondo Finance hires former Blockchain.com CFO Adam Schlisman
articles.snippet: The tokenized-assets firm appointed ex-Blockchain.com and Monashee executive as finance chief as it expands its onchain capital markets business.

articles.title: US Senate will vote on CLARITY crypto bill ‘without any question’ this week: Tim Scott
articles.snippet: The South Carolina lawmaker who heads the Senate Banking Committee said that the majority leader still had time to put the crypto bill on the agenda despite the narrow voting window.
